verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents an 'amount splits' feature configured on the payin in three steps, which covers splitting a charge. Merchant Billing Profiles set the fees billed to each merchant, which loosely supports the platform taking its cut. The snippets do not show splits across arbitrary sets of multiple sellers, the platform's cut as a split line, or any way to reverse or adjust a split later. Missing for 10: evidence of routing one charge to multiple sellers, reversal/adjustment of splits after the fact, explicit platform-fee split objects, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
